newsitem.title: USA: Capstone Pharmacy buys PharmaCare Inc.
newsitem.headline: Capstone Pharmacy buys PharmaCare Inc.

text.p: Capstone Pharmacy Services Inc said Friday it had acquired the assets of PharmaCare Inc in a cash deal.
It did not disclose the terms of the acquisition and company officials declined to comment.
Capstone nevertheless said the acquisition would add $5.5 million to its revenues.
Located in Vinton, Virginia, PharmaCare provides institutional pharmaceutical services in the state.

"(The) company ...will provide us with our initial entry into the state of Virginia," it said. "This acquisition is reflective of our strategy to acquire a significant platform pharmacy in each new market we enter."
Capstone is a provider of institutional pharmacy services to long-term care facilities.
In March, it bought Pennsylvania Prescriptions Inc, which does business as Emerald Drug Store.
